clips.title: The story
paras: Deep Elem Mine lies in central Silverpine Forest, its tunnels claimed by worgen. Once an active mine, it fell when Archmage Arugal's magic swept through the region and transformed its miners.

Deep Elem Mine once supplied the living people of Lordaeron with ore. When Archmage Arugal unleashed his lupine curse across Silverpine Forest, it spread through the tunnels. The laborers succumbed and became vicious worgen, abandoning their pickaxes to claim the cavern as a lair.
